# `aube access list packages`

- **Usage:** `aube access list packages [ENTITY]`
- **Effect:** read-only

List packages visible to the current user or an optional entity.

<!-- docs-navigation:start -->

Read the [workflow guide](/package-manager/publishing) for context.
[Global options](/cli/#global-flags) apply to this command too.

<!-- docs-navigation:end -->

## Arguments

- **`[ENTITY]`** — User, `@organization`, or `@scope:team`.

## Flags

- **`-h --help`** — Print help
